transcription: Transcribed by Claude from the original screenshots on 2026-10-14; must be independently checked by a human before it counts as golden data.

source.provided: original files from the game's screenshot folder (file names kept in conditions.originalFile)
source.redaction: Lossless block wipe with jpegtran -wipe (libjpeg-turbo 2.1.5) over the CURRENT BALANCE value and, in the captures with the r_DisplayInfo overlay (unselected-*), over its Session line; every pixel outside the rectangles is identical to the original.

location.note: A location pair: the unselected-* captures were taken first with the YOUR INVENTORIES field at its placeholder, then the same pages again with Seraphim Station selected. Each capture states its own locationDisplayedText.

localisation.note: The game's language file in use when the captures were taken. It is game content and is not committed; it lives in the private corpus next to the originals.

observations: Without a selected inventory the buy cards show no AVAILABLE CARGO SIZE row; with Seraphim Station selected every buy card shows it. The sell cards show it in both cases. This also explains the missing row at Patch City (patch-city-01, placeholder in every capture).

Without a selected inventory the centre of the kiosk shows 'PLEASE SELECT A VALID INVENTORY TO MAKE A TRANSACTION' on a red panel, and a hovered card gets a red frame and tint; with an inventory selected a hovered card gets a blue fill.
Apart from the cargo-size row, every value is identical between the two sets, taken about one minute apart.
Buy container sizes differ per commodity: 8-32 for Chlorine, Fluorine, Helium, Hydrogen, Copper, Aluminum, Potassium and Ammonia; 1-16 for Scrap; 1-32 for the rest. UEX lists 1-32 for Ammonia.

Five sell prices differ from UEX's latest values on the capture day: Agricultural Supplies 1,500 (UEX 1,400), Amioshi Plague 26,000 (27,000), DynaFlex 2,300 (1,800), Argon 520 (550), Ranta Dung 38,000 (39,000); Ranta Dung was rechecked at 4x zoom. Every buy price and every other sell price equals UEX.
The r_DisplayInfo overlay is on in the unselected-* captures only.
Beradom, Feynmaline and Glacosite are drawn without a commodity icon.
Ship Noise Countermeasures in buy-7 shows every field but is cut at the top border (O-132).
Steel is the only IN DEMAND card with stock (886 SCU, LOW INVENTORY); every other one shows 'OUT OF STOCK' with 0 SCU.
